prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on where you are in the Phoenix metro, what’s wrong, how quickly you need it fixed, and your budget. A few quick questions so I can give targeted recommendations:
- What is your ZIP code / neighborhood?  
- Is this an emergency (no cooling at all right now)?  
- Is this a repair on an existing unit or are you looking to replace/install a new system?  
- Any brand or unit age you know?

While you answer, here are immediate, practical steps and how to choose the best contractor:

Quick troubleshooting you can try now
- Check thermostat settings and batteries.  
- Make sure the circuit breaker for the AC is ON and the outdoor unit’s disconnect switch is ON.  
- Replace/clean the air filter (a clogged filter can stop cooling).  
- Check the outdoor unit for debris blocking airflow.  
If none of that helps, call a pro.

How to pick the best HVAC company in Phoenix
- Verify they’re licensed and insured: check Arizona Registrar of Contractors (ROC) license.  
- Look for NATE‑certified technicians (industry standard).  
- Check recent Google/Yelp/Angi and BBB ratings and read recent reviews for responsiveness and honesty about pricing.  
- Ask about warranties: parts and labor, and whether they honor manufacturer warranties.  
- Get at least 2–3 written, itemized estimates. Don’t hire just on price — compare scope, parts, and warranties.  
- Ask about a diagnostic/service fee and whether it’s credited toward repairs if you hire them.  
- Prefer companies that will pull permits for replacements and provide a written invoice and final system performance check.

Names to consider
- National brands with local Phoenix franchises (often reliable) include One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning, ARS/Rescue Rooter, and Aire Serv.  
- There are also many well-rated independent Phoenix companies — I can list several highly rated local options if you give your ZIP code.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether it’s an urgent outage and I’ll recommend 3–4 top-rated companies in your immediate area and give a sample list of questions to ask when you call.
